scripts.build: npm run check && npm run spfx:build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.format: prettier --write client shared scripts tests spfx/src vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check client shared scripts tests spfx/src vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: mkdir -p coverage && node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="shared/**" --test-coverage-exclude="shared/locales/**" --test-coverage-lines=95 --test-coverage-branches=85 --test-coverage-functions=95 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info tests/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.mjs
